episodes.title: Comeback
episodes.summary: Soon-to-be-wed Bae Seok-ryu returns to Korea and runs into her old friend Choi Seung-hyo. But she acts strangely around him, hiding a secret.

episodes.title: Hate
episodes.summary: Even as her loved ones ask for an explanation, Seok-ryu hides her vulnerabilities until a confrontation with her mom forces Seung-hyo to come to her aid.

episodes.title: Stop Line
episodes.summary: As Seok-ryu adjusts to unemployment, she faces anxiety about her stagnant life. Seung-hyo clashes with his partner after a tense business meeting.

episodes.title: Past Perfect
episodes.summary: When Seok-ryu's old company presents a promising opportunity, she and Seung-hyo collaborate. Later, an unsettling encounter leaves Seok-ryu rattled.

episodes.title: Go Back
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo starts acting awkwardly around Seok-ryu as old feelings resurface. To complicate things further, he faces a delicate situation at work.

episodes.title: Your First
episodes.summary: Seok-ryu explores a new career path, tapping into a childhood passion. However, her family faces a crisis when her father's secret comes to light.

episodes.title: Love is All About Timing
episodes.summary: A figure from Seok-ryu's past appears, leaving those around her looking for clarity — including Seung-hyo, who navigates his own complicated feelings.

episodes.title: His Secret
episodes.summary: As the truth finally comes out, Seung-hyo waits for Seok-ryu's response. Meanwhile, Seok-ryu's parents discover her new endeavor, sparking their fury.

episodes.title: Darkness in Life
episodes.summary: As Seok-ryu deals with an ailment, Seung-hyo and Song Hyeon-jun compete for her affection. But soon, Seung-hyo discovers the real reason for her return.

episodes.title: Bear in The Cave
episodes.summary: Seok-ryu's secret comes to light, leaving her loved ones struggling with the shock. When she goes missing, Seung-hyo desperately sets out to find her.

episodes.title: Belated
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo awaits Seok-ryu's genuine response as time passes since his confession. But suddenly, he receives a shocking announcement from his parents.

episodes.title: Puppy Love
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu try to navigate their new personal dynamic. Soon, feelings of jealousy arise, and they struggle to resolve a fight.

episodes.title: Love
episodes.summary: As their relationship blooms, Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu struggle to keep their status a secret. Jung Mo-eum finds out what's behind Kang Dan-ho's coldness.

episodes.title: Sweet Love
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo takes it into his own hands to encourage Seok-ryu's cooking ambitions. Convinced it's the right moment, he asks her an important question.

episodes.title: Bravo, My Life
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu face their parents' wrath after their secret is revealed — pushing the tension between their mothers to a boiling point.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu, happy in their relationship, prepare for a lifetime together. They inspire each other as they work toward their personal goals.
